newsitem.title: JAPAN: IWCC sees steady growth in copper mine output.
newsitem.headline: IWCC sees steady growth in copper mine output.

text.p: Global copper mine production will increase to 11,306,000 tonnes in 1997 and to 11,980,000 tonnes in 1998, compared with 10,762,000 tonnes last year, according to International Wrought Copper Council (IWCC) statistics.
The steady growth is mainly due to increased mine output in Argentina, Chile and Australia, the IWCC data showed,
Argentina copper mine output will reach 50,000 tonnes this year and jump to 180,000 tonnes in 1998, the data showed.
Chilean copper mine output, which totalled 3,066,000 tonnes last year, will increase to 3,306,000 tonnes in 1997 and 3,580,000 tonnes in 1998.
Australian copper mine output will grow to 619,000 tonnes in 1998 from an expected 580,000 tonnes this year and 510,000 tonnes last year, the data showed.
The copper statistics were compiled at the IWCC's 53rd joint meeting with copper producing and marketing companies in Kobe, western Japan, last week, and were given to Reuters on Tuesday.
